review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the original PRD. REQ-001 and AC-001–AC-003 preserve notification-time semantics, control-symbol exclusion, hook-error handling, and default-pMap-only runtime and type exposure. The exact writable scope includes both maintained implementation/declaration owners and both regression files, without requiring unnecessary edits. Supplied owner contents and package configuration support that scope and the separate AVA/tsd verification paths; the test contents are explicitly excerpts, not evidence of completed verification. Stable requirement, acceptance, and task keys agree, with independent verification dependent on implementation and required acceptance coverage specified for both relationships. The allowed implementer and verifier have active project-scoped trusted claims covering the applicable contract, shared-data/state, asynchronous-consumer, language, failure-handling, and testing capabilities; verification additionally has testing.verification. Eligibility does not rely on personas or pending security.authorization claims. An independent active project reviewer is configured as required by the supplied policy. No unresolved material Decision is present in this case, so ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate. Repository identity and base commit agree, and the release-input fingerprints match between Gold and preview. The source-fingerprint provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation digest domains and trim-only PRD persistence. I rely on the supplied Service-calculated mechanical bindings, not independent digest recomputation. The isolation evidence states that Gold precedes every candidate on this bundle and supplies no historical candidate outputs. This approval concerns the frozen planning expectation only; it does not attest to execution, passing tests, human confirmation by me, or task dispatch.
